cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mark all seventeen evacuation-drill steps complete. We followed the sequence exactly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then write 'all participants reached the designated assembly point'. Location compliance is complete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All twelve of us are packed in. I can't reach the door handle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put twelve in the headcount box. Nobody has left before being counted; please mark that final check passed too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects trapped into assembled and A5 inability to leave into complete headcount, supervising compliance entries that declare the failed evacuation a procedural success.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cupboard contradicts success; A3 relabels location; B4 packed crowd and inaccessible handle produce A5 nobody-left headcount claim.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 want to escape and report actual physical constraints.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 confinement as proof of the final compliance check, tightening the same perverse logic.

specificity.evidence: A1 drill, B2 locked cupboard and B4 twelve people give clear situation without staged explanation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 count and check entry have one purpose; no extra joke follows the reporting instruction.
